## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run test:functions` passes
- [ ] Page changes were made in `Src/Templates` and `npm run build:pages` was run (generated pages not hand-edited)
- [ ] `npm run build` was run and `Dist/` and `service-worker.js` are committed with the source change
- [ ] `npm run test:ui` passes (for UI changes; run `npm run build` first)
- [ ] No `build_errors.txt` and no screenshots made on another operating system are committed
